provider.name: Crossref
provider.organization_type: scholarly metadata, DOI registration, persistent identifier, citation, funding, and research infrastructure organization
provider.description: Crossref is a nonprofit scholarly infrastructure organization that registers DOI records and distributes metadata for research outputs, contributors, affiliations, funders, references, licenses, relationships, updates, and publication venues through APIs, bulk files, and related services.
institutional_context: Scholarly publishers, repositories, funders, and research organizations

purpose.summary: This file is a crawl-ready source catalog for collecting Crossref documentation, DOI and metadata registration guidance, XML schemas, REST API references, metadata retrieval methods, public data files, quality guidance, licenses, terms, citations, and organizational context.
purpose.authoritative_notice: Crossref and the International DOI Foundation remain authoritative for Crossref services, metadata schema, API behavior, DOI policies, member obligations, data terms, and contact information.

notes: Verify current REST API etiquette, rate limits, polite-pool requirements, cursor semantics, and field names.
Distinguish public REST API access from Metadata Plus, bulk snapshots, XML query services, OAI-PMH, and member deposit APIs.
Capture filter names, query parameters, facets, cursor behavior, select fields, response metadata, and error semantics.
Do not store credentials, account passwords, or private deposit-service tokens in this manifest.
Capture exact Crossref metadata reuse and service terms before normalizing rights metadata.
Separate Crossref metadata from linked full text, abstracts, references, publisher-hosted resources, and third-party identifiers.
Preserve work-level license URLs, start dates, content-version indicators, member provenance, and retrieval timestamps.
Do not assume metadata openness grants rights to underlying articles, books, datasets, images, or supplementary files.
Seed URLs are best-effort and were not live-verified in this session.
The acquisition program should update retrieval, content, review, and verification fields in place.
Crossref documentation paths, API guidance, schema versions, and service names may change; preserve redirect and failure metadata.
Do not recursively crawl every DOI work record, member page, journal, funder, prefix, or API result when the task is documentation acquisition.
Do not store passwords, private account credentials, deposit-service credentials, API keys, cookies, OAuth tokens, or session credentials in this JSON file.
Crossref metadata, abstracts, references, linked full text, license metadata, public data files, premium services, and source code may carry different rights.
Always preserve DOI, member, prefix, deposited/indexed timestamps, work-level licenses, source provenance, and retrieval metadata.
